entries.prompt: Create one scientific educational asset for a Year 11 physics explainer. A single plain white A4 sheet, horizontal, viewed almost edge-on from slightly above so its rectangular upper surface is narrow in depth, slight curl at one corner, faint real paper fibres. Ink outlines with delicate neutral watercolour shading, matching a hand painted school apparatus illustration. Sheet long side spans 80 percent of a wide landscape canvas. Isolated on a genuinely transparent background, at least 8 percent clear margin all sides. No ground, backdrop, shadow rectangle, glow, text, labels, numbers, hands, people, faces, logos or extra objects. This sheet will be animated falling horizontally, so show the full outline and keep it flat.
entries.editPrompt: Clean only the outer contour of the supplied painted white paper sheet. Preserve sheet shape, subtle texture, perspective, curled corner, dimensions and ink outline. Remove the stray white flecks and coloured fringing outside the intended continuous sheet silhouette. Make all pixels outside that contour fully transparent, with a smooth antialiased edge and no halo or added shadow. Do not crop the sheet or change its material. Add nothing.
entries.finding: No material contour or background defect in correctly alpha-composited QA.
